notes.text:
An update is available for kernel.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: ALSA: caiaq: fix out-of-bounds read in the Traktor Kontrol S4 input parser (CVE-2026-64487)

* kernel: scsi: target: Bound PR-OUT TransportID parsing to the received buffer (CVE-2026-72084)

* kernel: RDMA/srpt: fix integer overflow in immediate data length check (CVE-2026-74394)

* kernel: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in ib_free_cq() (CVE-2026-92508)

* kernel: uio: Fix stale info pointer in failed registration path (CVE-2026-93054)

* kernel: RDMA/core: Fix potential use after free in ib_destroy_cq_user() (CVE-2026-92511)

* kernel: IB/isert: reject login PDUs declaring more data than was received (CVE-2026-90413)

* kernel: IB/isert: reject PDUs declaring more data than was received (CVE-2026-90414)

* kernel: IB/isert: delay the final Login Response until the session is registered (CVE-2026-90294)

* kernel: tcp: prevent collapsing skbs across boundary in rtx queue (CVE-2026-98549)

* kernel: kernel: Privilege escalation via use-after-free in event tracing subsystem (CVE-2026-99235)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via race condition in TCP socket lookup (CVE-2026-99288)

* kernel: kernel: Memory corruption via integer overflow in GUP-fast (CVE-2026-99661)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [Rocky Linux-8.10.z] RDMA/ulps: Backport security fixes (JIRA:Rocky Linux-289994)

* [Rocky Linux-8.10.z] RDMA: Backport security fixes (JIRA:Rocky Linux-296076)

* [Rocky Linux 8.10] Incorrect swap size value in /proc/swaps if swap area is very big (JIRA:Rocky Linux-302561)

* lockd: fix vfs_test_lock() calls (JIRA:Rocky Linux-304667)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
